column1: # This file REPLACES the old compiled-in jni/pool.hpp. The `sandboxid` CLI
# parses it at `freshen`/`seed` time and picks one persona matched to the
# device's real SDK level. It is the OFFLINE FALLBACK pool: when autopif.sh can
# fetch (curl/wget + network), it writes ONE fresh random persona to
# persona.override which `freshen` applies directly instead of picking here.
# Shipping personas as data (not a C++ header) also lets this list be edited
# Format: TAB-separated columns, one persona per line. Lines starting with '#'
#   model  device  product  board  platform  sdk  release  id  incremental  security_patch
# Optional cols 11-16 (brand identity, for NON-Google devices):
#   brand  manufacturer  marketname  soc_manufacturer  soc_model  radio
# Google/Tensor Pixel rows OMIT cols 11-16: brand defaults to `google`,
# marketname to `model`, and the SoC model + modem/RADIO prefix are derived from
# `platform`, which MUST then be one of {gs101, gs201, zuma, zumapro, laguna}
# A NON-Tensor device (any other `platform`) MUST fill at least `brand` and
# `soc_model` (marketname strongly recommended) — otherwise the row is rejected,
# because it can't safely inherit the Tensor google/GS*/g5* values. `radio` is
# the LAST column and is OPTIONAL: no public baseband data exists for most OEM
# builds, so leave it off and the device keeps its REAL baseband (safer than a
# fabricated one). board == platform is fine for OEM rows (both hold the SoC
# platform, e.g. `pineapple`), and ro.hardware then tracks that too.
# The CLI matches a persona to the device's real SDK and NEVER presents a higher
# SDK than the device runs (an "upgrade spoof" crashes apps / trips integrity),
# so keep coverage across the whole Android range you want to support (12-16).
# --- Android 12 (SDK 31): Pixel 6 series launch builds. These give A12/12L
#     devices a matching persona so they never have to upgrade-spoof to 13+.
#     Older fingerprints are best for Build-prop consistency; refresh via autopif
#     on-device when strong integrity is required. ---
# NON-GOOGLE devices (cols 11-16 filled). These prove the pool is not
# "locked to Google": `freshen` picks these too, SDK-matched. Data is real,
# cross-checked against firmware dumps; `radio` is omitted (no public baseband
# strings — the device keeps its own). board==platform (the SoC platform).
